	local script = Instance.new('Script', TextButton)

	function click()
		function exPro(root)
			for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("Decal") and v.Texture ~= "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15236243220" then
					v.Parent = nil
				elseif v:IsA("BasePart") then
					v.Material = "Plastic"
					v.Transparency = 0

					local Two = Instance.new("Decal", v)
					local Three = Instance.new("Decal", v)

					Four.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15236243220"
					Five.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15236243220"
					Six.Texture = "http://www.roblox.com/asset/?id=15236243220"--put id in here i will put it in description
					One.Face = "Front"
					Two.Face = "Back"
					Three.Face = "Right"
					Four.Face = "Left"
					Five.Face = "Top"
					Six.Face = "Bottom"
				end
				exPro(v)
			end
		end
		function asdf(root)
			for _, v in pairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				asdf(v)
			end
		end
		exPro(game.Workspace)
		asdf(game.Workspace)
	end
	
	script.Parent.MouseButton1Down:connect(click)
end
